title: Build the V4 Guards 1.1.0 README release candidate
goal: Ship a hash-bound root project README and version the completed P9 Web Companion as a certified V4 Guards 1.1.0 candidate without changing the stable API or activating IFX adoption.
acceptanceCriteria: The root V4 README is canonical, required package authority and present in deterministic installed distributions.
Product, Host and Web Companion versions are 1.1.0 while API 1.0 and unchanged module/Profile component versions remain compatible.
Release notes and maintained documentation describe the shipped P9 surface and its exclusions accurately.
All changed tests are hash-bound by the CI contract and package compatibility authorities are refreshed exactly.
Windows-full and Linux-complete certification pass against one clean commit and package hash.
No publication, IFX profile, cutover, workflow/ruleset activation or Reset UI expansion occurs in the candidate change.
